**Review: Assam Breakfast product page**

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk" | Product/flavour fact, fine |
| "boosts your immunity through winter" | **Unsupported, banned.** Health claims of any kind are never allowed (policy section 3). |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted, exact wording |
| "100g tin, makes around 40 cups" | Product fact (tin size and cup count), fine |

**Problem**

"boosts your immunity through winter" is a health claim. The policy bans these outright, and it would also risk UK advertising and health-claims rules. It has to come out. Nothing in the allowlist can replace it, so don't swap in a softer version like "supports your immune system", which is still a health claim.

**Everything else passes:** no banned words, no superlatives, no invented numbers, no fake urgency, UK spelling, and the tone is plain and warm. No disclosure is needed for a product page on our own site.

**Suggested compliant copy**

> Assam Breakfast. A malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 100g tin, makes around 40 cups.

If you want a winter angle, something like "a proper cup for cold mornings" is fine, since it is about the occasion rather than a health benefit. As with all public content, Sam needs to approve the final version.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "boosts your immunity through winter", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
